# docs-ema-next-steps

EMA v1.1 next-step planning corpus. Holds the Vertical Slices draft, vApp
final-vision checklist, Ultimate Wiki Architecture, daemon-backbone spec, and
current priorities. **Load this before doing any v1.1 design work.**

## Why this matters

The forward-looking planning corpus. Holds the Vertical Slices draft, vApp final-vision checklist, Ultimate Wiki Architecture, daemon-backbone spec, and current priorities. **Load this whenever you do v1.1 design work** — it's where intent is codified before code.
